messages:
Maya K: Quick check — final on-site (panel 3) 11am PT tomorrow. Need one backup for that slot (system infra). Also, tiny ask: please add 1-2 bullet 'CR takeaways' on the debrief doc after the interview. Link below. @Samir Patel @Elena R

Samir Patel: I can cover as backup if needed. Confirm timezone? 11am PT works for me. I'll grab recording permission.

Elena R: I'm on the panel already for the 10am slot, can't do 11. Priya might be available — tagging @Priya S.

Priya S: I can cover 11am PT. Quick q: on the rubric — do we mark 'System depth' under Architecture or Performance? The docs mentioned Architecture but I've seen people mark Perf.

Maya K: Good catch — treat 'System depth' as Architecture for now. We should update the rubric text before the next cycle; I'll file a tiny tweak. For this panel please put it under Architecture.

InterviewOps Bot: Reminder — debrief form: https://redwood.example/debriefs/xyz (use the 'CR takeaways' field). Please add recordings and short timestamps if possible :thumbsup:.

Samir Patel: One more practical note on CR notes: if you review candidate repo, paste a very short diff-like snippet + a `+/-` summary into the debrief. Example:
```
+ handled concurrency with worker pool
- missing cache invalidation plan
```
That makes post-hire comparisons easier.

Maya K: Great. Changing panel lineup: Priya backup for 11am. Samir will help collect recording permissions and upload links. I'll update calendar and send note to candidate (and add a 5-min warmup buffer).

Priya S: got it. small ask — can we do a 5-min warm-up handoff for panelists? means join at 10:55 + quick role split (who asks design vs coding vs ops).

Elena R: Agree — please add 5-min buffer on the calendar invite and call it 'panel warmup'.

Maya K: Done. Calendar updated and I filed a tiny rubric doc tweak ticket. Thanks everyone :heart: 

InterviewOps Bot: Schedule updated: panel 3 backup set to Priya S, 5-min warmup added. Debrief link reminder sent 30m before candidate start.
